first_error_evidence: Step 3: Agent wrote airline_analysis.py implementing find_max_gap() which maximizes the gap over all offset configurations, producing 99. The task requires the minimum over configurations (guaranteed gap), not the maximum. Step 4 confirmed wrong output of 99.
verification_evidence: Step 10: Agent reads /app/results.txt and confirms it contains 79. Step 13: Agent runs verify_result.py to cross-check the result, confirming the 79-day gap. Step 14: Final read of results.txt reconfirms 79.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent initially implemented the wrong objective (maximizing gap over all schedule configurations), self-corrected after recognizing the problem requires the minimum-of-maximum-gaps guarantee, then re-ran the corrected brute-force search to produce the correct answer of 79.
